notes.title: Gamepad Update
notes.notes:
Gamepad support was already added some time ago, but, but lacked visual indications, so they were added at the beginning of the game and during any time in the game by holding the R2/RT button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576885/ff9017df4de42bb7af2c548e997681a006bfc184.png[/img]

notes.title: General improvements in the hospital and more!
Improvements to hospital stealth gameplay and more!
SAFE PUZZLE CHANGES
notes.notes:
Due to the low number of players who achieved the "Morphine" achievement (acquired by completing the safe puzzle) I decided to make new changes to this puzzle. In order to make it easier.

Now the safe contains all the numbers:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576885/1b44c8d60459a3523c86bb3756507b27fb3f5cae.png[/img]

Since the number indication is completely on the safe, an explanation of alternating rotation has been added in its place.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576885/770a506fe7b9cb955ded17e11a83ed32eb0d8382.png[/img]

Now the password only has three numbers. There are commas between each number, to avoid confusion:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576885/424fc99fc28c8ed6d62bee62a5cbdac0c4bbc434.png[/img]

notes.title: NERF IN THE SAFE PUZZLE AND MORE CHANGES
notes.notes:
Hospital:
- Safe Puzzle easier. Before, the player would need to understand the logic behind the progression to extract the 3 numbers. Now they are provided directly, along with their colors. There is a new text indicating how to apply these three numbers to the other paper, to generate the password:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576885/c2d9f2fb98773920eb6d5e8e29865500b6529ff0.png[/img]

Mantis Hideout:
 - Secret room key position changed.
 - Arrows were strategically positioned in the maze.

Ending 2:
 - Improvement in the tip the game gives you at the end 1.
 - Improvement in the tip that the game gives you [spoiler]when you get the number of stabs in the hospital correct[/spoiler]

notes.title: VCR PUZZLE IMPROVEMENTS AND MORE!
notes.notes:
VCR Puzzle:
 - Previously, to find the correct position of the plugs the player needed to check that the yellow/red wires were cut and replaced (looking at the tape on the cables), this was causing a lot of confusion among players. Therefore I changed the puzzle so that the plugs have the correct position defined simply by color.
- New way of checking the puzzle: Now every time the player changes one of the small wires or connects a plug, the game will check if the puzzle is correct and if so, the puzzle will disappear, the TV will turn on and the "Fix" button will be blocked, as it is no longer necessary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576885/058eb9948f67bce1ed9caf17d802bff96c80843a.png[/img]

Mantis Hideout:
 - In the chase where there is the shooting tutorial, the camera could get stuck in a position too low, preventing the chase from being seen - [SOLVED]
 - Final chase before [spoiler]Ritual[/spoiler], when shooting the real Mantis his animation would get stuck in the "Getting Shot" state.- [SOLVED]

Pause Menu:
 - In the options, if the player had the "volume" option activated and went back to the pause main menu by pressing the "C" key, the processing of the volume option would remain active, even after returning to the game. - [SOLVED]

Hospital:
 - On the fourth floor, there was a collisionless wall. [SOLVED]
 - Problems with kitchen and safe checkpoints. If the player reached the checkpoint without killing the nurse at the entrance. It would be active when loading the checkpoint and the player would be unable to leave. Something similar could happen with the safe checkpoint, if the player did not kill the nurse in the previous room.[SOLVED]
 - If the player entered the cafeteria without killing the nurse at the door. When you return, the nurse would instantly detect during the transition. Now he has a delay, giving the player the chance to kill him. Something similar could happen to the nurse in the waiting room, which is before the safe puzzle. [SOLVED]
 - The hospital door, which serves as a hiding place, in the room just before the offices has been improved. To avoid bugs where the player kills the nurse and disappears.

Language:
 - Now the game starts in the same language as your computer. Unless there is another language saved by the player.

notes.title: SAFE PUZZLE - IMPROVEMENTS/BUG FIXES
notes.notes:
BUG THAT PREVENTED THE INSERT OF SOME NUMBERS FIXED:
Emergency patch release, due to a bug that caused some numbers not to be computed in the safe, preventing the completion of the puzzle and progression in the game. Apparently the bug only happened on some computers. The code has been improved so that these bugs no longer occur.

PUZZLE IMPROVEMENTS:
I added some "guide numbers" to the safe to make it easier to see the code the player is entering:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576885/d2c43a0e15cd908a93227d16786b359d70f0024d.png[/img]

The book has been improved, giving the player more tips on how to approach the puzzle:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44576885/bdd4790b8b2e83182f76b84657c7645004932dbc.png[/img]

Other updates with fixes are coming, but I had to release this one urgently because it is a bug that was preventing some players from finishing the game.

Again, I hope this helps improve people's experience with the game!

notes.title: BIG UPDATE - TO IMPROVE THE EXPERIENCE FOR EVERYONE ! :)
notes.notes:
Bugs fixed/Improvements

Hospital Safe Puzzle:
 - It was too difficult, some extra tips were added to improve the experience
 - A guide made by me has been added to the community in case you are REALLY stuck
 - When interacting with the book, the player continued in the running animation and making sound. [SOLVED]

VCR Puzzle:
 - When the 3 plugs were connected and you selected an empty slot, the plugs would lock and stay stuck in that position [SOLVED]
 - Tip added when choosing plugs/connectors. Small arrows will indicate a detail that was often overlooked.
 - Indication that the VCR is ready to receive the tape as soon as the wires are in the correct position and return to the VHS general menu. The TV will turn orange and sound like static. The "Repair" button will be blocked as it is no longer needed.

Ending 2 Puzzle:
 - When the game was in English, an important clue to solving the puzzle was not shown [spoiler] You should select the "Revenge" tape, so a part of the password for the vault would appear, but it was only working when the game was in Portuguese -BR[/spoiler] [SOLVED]
 - Password generation for the [spoiler]hideout vault[/spoiler], when the player opens the game for the first time, the expected behavior was the generation of a single password that would be saved forever. But the game was generating a password for each launch. [SOLVED]

Circuit Breaker Puzzle:
 - If the player activate the circuit breaker and spamm the exit button, the game could continue processing the puzzle and the game would possibly crash [SOLVED]
 - When activating the interaction with the circuit breaker at the edge of the interaction area, the player could fall outside, which would jam the back button and the player would be trapped. [SOLVED]
 - Activating the bookshelf and then spamming the back button (C) locks the player onto the bookshelf. [SOLVED]

Mantis Hideout:
 - In the last chase, there was a part of the corridor with no wall tiles. [SOLVED]
 - In the first chase, if the player tried to shoot the Mantis, the camera would lock in the current position [SOLVED]

Observation:
 - I received a feedback, a suspicion that the numbers were not being computed in the safe puzzle at the hospital. I did several tests and found that everything was normal.


I hope these changes make the experience more enjoyable for as many people as possible :)
